about: PERMAFLEET cross-org squadrons, shown on the PERMAFLEET page (unit paths from contracts/roles.dot). `role` and `body` are trusted HTML.

squadrons.name: ALPHA SQUADRON
squadrons.role: Elite fighters · run by G00N SQUAD
squadrons.body: The tip of the spear for PERMAFLEET, drawn from the top of BRAVO SQUADRON. Applications are open below. Signing up is also how you join G00N SQUAD, even if you’re already in PERMAFLEET.

squadrons.name: BRAVO SQUADRON
squadrons.body: Fighter pilots from every member org who fly security for PERMAFLEET. Official training runs on Friday Night Fights.

squadrons.name: RAT SQUADRON
squadrons.body: PERMAFLEET’s pirates. Members are selected by leadership.

squadrons.name: GHOST SQUADRON
squadrons.body: Part of SPECIAL OPERATIONS, open to PERMAFLEET officers.

squadrons.name: TURTLE BRIGADE
squadrons.body: Basic infantry training. The best go on to SHELLBACK, the elite infantry unit.
